image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tabby cat resting on white bedding. The cat's eyes are closed, suggesting it is sleeping or dozing. The fur shows distinct dark stripes on a brownish-grey background, characteristic of a mackerel or classic tabby pattern. A portion of the tail is visible in the upper right, and a paw is partially visible in the lower left.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pattern appears to be a mix of mackerel (stripes) and classic elements, fitting the general tabby definition.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the fur texture around the ears and cheeks. AI generators often struggle with the transition from fine whiskers/fur to the background, resulting in haloing or melting. Verify if the 'M' marking is structurally integrated into the fur flow or painted on top. Check for any asymmetry in the ear shapes that might indicate structural collapse.
